methodology.probability: Normal approximation from the frozen projection pool P10/P90 interval.
methodology.warning: These probabilities are not market-calibrated or certification-authorized.
methodology.support_rule: Absolute model-market disagreement above 15pp is retained but excluded as OUT_OF_SUPPORT.
methodology.ranking: Within each week: estimated side probability, then no-vig advantage.
methodology.line_ladder: Every available book x threshold is preserved. D(L) equals model over probability minus the two-sided no-vig market over probability. Ladder patterns are diagnostic only and do not grant selection authority.
